items.title: Louis Nelson Interview, 1960-04-18
items.q: And we had, I just remember that guitar player, it was Rene Hall. Then we had Adolf Alexander on sax, Theodore Poinel, and Sam Dutre on tenor.

ctx.x: And we had, I just remember that guitar player, it was Rene Hall. Then we had Adolf Alexander on sax, Theodore Poinel, and Sam Dutre on tenor.
Was that young Sam Dutre or the old man?
